q: The Zimmer program concerns actions of lattices Γ in higher-rank semisimple Lie groups (e.g., SL(n,ℝ), n ≥ 3) on compact manifolds. The central conjecture is:
opts: Such actions are always algebraic—arising from representations of the group
The smallest manifold admitting a non-trivial action has dimension ≥ n−1
All such actions preserve a smooth volume form
exp: Zimmer's conjecture: lattices in higher-rank groups cannot act smoothly on low-dimensional manifolds. Brown-Fisher-Hurtado proved (2020) that SL(n,ℤ) cannot act on manifolds of dimension < n−1 by volume-preserving diffeomorphisms.
